title: One Event, One Gear Plan
eyebrow: Bookings and Event operations · Wisconsin Creative
lede: A reservation now behaves as one living event gear plan, with clear reuse, repair, and event-day controls instead of duplicate rows.

stats.n: Matching same-person, same-title, same-event submissions consolidate into the existing plan
Reserved, pickup, partial, checked-out, and returned states share one operational summary
Lifecycle, merge, list route, decision, and native source-contract coverage

changes.h: A second submit created a second reservation
changes.was: People could split one event's equipment across duplicate reservation rows, creating extra pickup work and unclear ownership.
changes.now: Compatible gear is added to the existing event plan. Different pickup details or a started pickup stop with a direct link to the existing plan.

changes.h: Duplicate copied the old event context
changes.was: The action cloned title, dates, events, and equipment together, making accidental same-event duplication easy.
changes.now: Reuse gear opens a fresh composer, requires a different event, remembers pickup location, and rechecks every item.

changes.was: Staff had no safe way to combine matching rows or update an event-day batch.
changes.now: Selection supports previewed merge, pickup-location changes, owner transfer, and cancellation with partial-progress truth.

changes.h: Event gear state was a count
changes.was: Operators could see totals but not one readiness answer per person.
changes.now: Event detail shows one person row with item count, readiness state, and a visible combine cue when legacy plans remain.

verification: Focused tests: 78 passing across reservation creation, consolidation, list routes, and native source contracts.
Web gates: TypeScript, ESLint, docs verification, migration-prefix check, codemap generation, and production-shaped build:app pass.
Native gates: Wisconsin iPhone 16 Pro app build and test-target compilation pass; iOS drift, audit inventory, and project checks pass.
Runtime limitation: The authenticated Preview server reached the sign-in boundary, but no test credential or fixture-backed web session was available for a truthful matched capture.
notes: No production records were changed. Emma Hanson's existing rows still require the new staff merge action after deployment.
Matched before/after screenshots are intentionally omitted: using the sign-in screen, different data, or reconstructed UI would not prove the booking changes.
Deployment, authenticated browser interaction, and physical kiosk/scanner acceptance remain separate gates.
